subject: Interview: SWE II — logistics, ASL request & interviewer playbook
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha@brightstaff.co>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Interview scheduling — Redwood (SWE II)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for speaking with Samantha. We'd like to schedule your final loop for the SWE II role at Redwood. Here are two options (all PST):

- Wed Mar 3, 10:00–11:20 AM — technical + system design + manager
- Wed Mar 3, 2:00–3:20 PM — technical + system design + manager

Can you confirm which works best and whether you need any accessibility accommodations (ASL, extra time between segments, live captions, etc.)? If yes, please attach the accommodation form (I can send it to you) or share details here.

Panel: Markus Klein (hiring manager), Tessa Morgan (senior SWE), Maya Srinivasan (infra SWE).

I'll hold both slots for now and send the day-of playbook once confirmed. Attaching the role brief and a copy of the interview rubric for transparency.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett | Senior Technical Recruiter
Redwood Inference
Attachments: role_brief_SWEII.pdf (stub), interview_rubric.pdf (stub)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha@brightstaff.co>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling — Redwood (SWE II)

Hi Laura,

Thanks — I can do the 10:00–11:20 AM slot on Wed Mar 3. I do have a few accessibility needs: I use an ASL interpreter for live conversations and I request a 10-minute break between the technical challenge and the system design portion so I can regroup. I downloaded the accommodation form and attached it here (accommodation_form_alex_rivera.pdf).

Also attaching my resume in case the panel needs it ahead of time.

Best,
Alex Rivera

Attachments: alex_rivera_resume.pdf, accommodation_form_alex_rivera.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling — Redwood (SWE II)

Team —

Thanks, Laura and Alex. Alex confirmed the 10:00–11:20 AM slot and needs ASL interpretation + a 10-minute buffer between the coding and design segments. Action items: 

- Laura: please confirm we can book an ASL interpreter for 10:00–11:30 (to cover potential overrun) and add the accommodation file to the candidate folder.
- Tessa: you'll lead the coding exercise (30 min). Please allow an additional 10 minutes for a short break after the exercise for Alex to consult with the interpreter.
- Maya: please own system design (30 min) and keep the discussion at a high level — we want to avoid low-level time pressure.

Day-of logistics / playbook (attached interviewer_playbook.pdf): includes Zoom link, order, suggested prompts, and a 5-minute warm welcome script. Quick notes inside the playbook: do not share puzzles that require whiteboard hand gestures without simultaneous captioning; call on the interpreter to confirm intent when necessary.

Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/92734951234 (passcode in day-of note). I'll be host and will spotlight the interpreter when they join. Backup contact (phone): Laura +1 (415) 555-0123.

I attached Alex's resume for quick reference. Let me know if any conflicts.

- Markus
Markus Klein | Engineering Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference
Attachments: alex_rivera_resume.pdf, interviewer_playbook.pdf

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interview scheduling — Redwood (SWE II)

Sounds good — I'll lead the coding exercise and will schedule the buffer. A couple of quick things:

- Can someone confirm whether the coding question will be on CoderPad or a shared Google Doc? I prefer CoderPad for execution, but we should confirm the candidate is comfortable.
- I will share a short 1-paragraph preface to the exercise (objective + success criteria) in the playbook.

If the interpreter joins via Zoom, I can spotlight them during the problem statement. I confirm I will avoid gestural hints and will use explicit verbal cues.

Thanks, Tessa

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 08:00:00 -0700
Subject: Day-of — SWE II interview (Wed Mar 3, 10:00 AM PST)

Hi all — final day-of logistics below. Small changes from the playbook are inline.

Zoom join: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/92734951234
Passcode: Redwood2027!
Dial-in (US): +1 415 555 0100 (then enter 92734951234#)
Calendar invite: attached (zoom_invite.ics)
Interpretation: ASL interpreter is booked from 9:55–11:35 AM. Markus will spotlight the interpreter on join.
Coding environment: CoderPad (link will be posted in the chat at 10:05). Tessa confirmed.
Order / timing (10:00–11:20):
- 10:00–10:05 — welcome & introductions (Markus)
- 10:05–10:40 — coding (Tessa)
- 10:40–10:50 — break / buffer (candidate + interpreter)
- 10:50–11:20 — system design (Maya)

Please do not record. If you need to step away, annotate the calendar event and cc Laura so we can swap in the backup panelist.
Attachments: interviewer_playbook.pdf (final), alex_rivera_resume.pdf (candidate), accommodation_form_alex_rivera.pdf
Thanks everyone — see you at 10.
Laura

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@gmail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Cho <samantha@brightstaff.co>
Date: Wed, 03 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Day-of — SWE II interview (Wed Mar 3, 10:00 AM PST)

Thanks — I confirm the 10:00 AM slot and appreciate you booking the interpreter and adding the break. I got the calendar invite and the playbook. I prefer CoderPad, so that's great. See you shortly.

Best,
Alex
